title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE English as a Second Language Component 1 (Reading and Writing)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE English as a Second Language 0510 Component 1 (Reading and Writing): four reading exercises and two writing exercises, 2 hours, 60 marks. The multiple-choice exercise uses four options where the real paper uses three. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its texts and questions are not past-paper material.
instructions:
Answer **all** the exercises. You have 2 hours.

- Exercises 1 to 4 (30 marks) test reading; Exercises 5 and 6 (15 marks each) ask for 120-160 words of continuous writing: an informal email and a more formal piece.
- Dictionaries may not be used.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, matching and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Component 1 of the 2027-2029 syllabus. The Listening component (Component 2) and the Speaking test cannot be simulated here. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
